SELECT t.id AS taskId ,t.name AS taskName,t.plan_start_time, t.plan_end_time,t.charge_name,t.reality_start_time,t.status AS taskState, date_part('day',t.plan_end_time-t.plan_start_time) AS expectedDay, p.name AS productName FROM project_task t INNER JOIN product_info p on p.id=t.product_id WHERE t.product_id IN
#{productId}

SELECT t.id AS taskId,t.name AS taskName,t.type,t.priority,t.plan_start_time, t.pre_task_id,t.create_time,t.phase_name,t.update_time,t.create_user_name, t.charge_id AS taskChargeId,t.charge_name AS taskChargeName,t.pre_task_id, t.product_id, pi.charge_name AS productChargeName,pi.charge_id AS productChargeId, pi.name AS productName,pj.charge_id AS projectChargeId,pj.charge_name AS projectChargeName FROM project_task t INNER JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id=t.product_id INNER JOIN project_info pj ON pj.id=t.project_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId}
